profiles.rationale: The development recipes forward two declared recipe parameters and invoke pinned toolchain and setup commands.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact parameterized test, formatting, dependency-baseline, and mise setup invocations are accepted and the complete Justfile matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The bootstrap security fixture must construct and mutate only its isolated temporary repositories.
profiles.safety_invariant: Every accepted dynamic command is an exact argument tuple and the complete fixture source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The developer bootstrap installs the repository's pinned mise tools and writes the mise lock only when one is absent.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact mise install and lock invocations are accepted and the complete developer bootstrap source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The installer runs one caller-selected Cargo executable and copies reviewed build and documentation artifacts to caller-selected installation prefixes.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the two documented Cargo builds and three install operations are accepted and the complete installer source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The dependency audit aggregates failures from six required workspace and audit-tool dependency checks.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact six failure-recording calls are accepted and the complete script, including final failure propagation, matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The PostgreSQL smoke test redacts credentials from container logs before emitting failure diagnostics.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact three-expression stderr redaction pipeline is accepted and the complete smoke-test source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The protected bootstrap constructs an isolated snapshot with authenticated system commands, runs only reviewed gate scripts, and preserves audit evidence beneath validated roots.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact snapshot setup, cleanup, archive, evidence, and gate invocation tuples are accepted and the complete bootstrap source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The gate runner uses authenticated system and Rust-tool paths while preparing and executing the isolated maintainability check.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact authenticated setup, cleanup, bootstrap, Cargo, fmt, and Clippy invocations are accepted and the complete runner source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The source-safety runner invokes only absolute tool paths supplied by the authenticated maintainability bootstrap.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the five exact Cargo, fmt, and Clippy invocations are accepted and the complete runner source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The local review wrapper launches Claude with a minimal environment and fixed isolation controls, drains the complete review process group with bounded TERM-to-KILL escalation, then removes its validated scratch directory.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact high-effort isolated Claude launch and validated cleanup tuple are accepted; cleanup verifies that the review process group is gone before removing scratch data, and the complete wrapper source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The wrapper tests create fake Claude and process-listing executables, exercise TERM-resistant, zombie-only, and stopped descendants, then clean only their isolated temporary fixture paths.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact fixture process, symlink, and cleanup tuples are accepted; success, failure, signal, zombie-only, and stopped-group paths prove descendants and scratch data are gone or fail closed, and the complete test source matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The GPU release job packages the reviewed binary and runtime, verifies the extracted artifact, exercises required CUDA success and failure modes, and records bounded evidence.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact package extraction, staged-binary, CUDA gate, doctor, evidence transformation, and reversible dependency-move tuples are accepted and the complete workflow matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: CI packages and extracts the Linux and Windows preview artifacts, resolves the generated binaries, and exercises their version and help commands.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact archive discovery, extraction, Git configuration, generated-binary smoke, and Windows staging tuples are accepted and the complete workflow matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The release workflow verifies the annotated tag and main ancestry, extracts reviewed artifacts, smoke-tests the binaries, and publishes the exact release assets.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact tag verification, main fetch, artifact extraction, Windows smoke-copy, and GitHub release tuples are accepted and the complete workflow matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The reusable release smoke workflow downloads, verifies, extracts, and exercises the selected Linux and Windows release artifacts in isolated runner paths.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only exact release download, extraction, smoke-binary, response-validation, and Windows staging tuples are accepted and the complete workflow matches the current reviewed digest.

profiles.rationale: The protected workflow resolves a branch-shaped merge-group base to an exact commit before invoking the authenticated gate from the protected checkout.
profiles.safety_invariant: Only the exact Git commit-resolution tuple is accepted outside the separately pinned protected-dispatch sequence, and the complete workflow matches the current reviewed digest.
